Given that Mary is not wearing her favourite earrings, find the probability she is wearing yellow.

Inconclusive tests are followed by a thorough examination. The examination detects the condition in 99% of patients who have it. It reports the condition in 0.001% of patients who do not have it.
Given that a patient does not have the condition, find the probability of a final positive result.
